markScheme.exemplarAnswer: A grade 9 response will: describe current local government powers and funding; argue for more power (local decisions better reflect needs, devolution works for Scotland/Wales, democratic accountability is stronger locally); argue against (postcode lottery risk, national standards ensure equality, local areas may lack expertise and resources); evaluate funding crisis (austerity cuts, rising demand, Section 114 notices); conclude: local government needs significant additional funding to deliver existing responsibilities, and some additional powers (especially over transport and housing) would improve local democracy. However, strong national frameworks are needed to ensure minimum standards.
